about_the_game:
Give your magical forest an uncommon vibe with the KR Phosphor Forest Tileset! Kokoro Reflections is here with a MV-sized tileset perfect for making a dark dungeon deep in the middle of a forest. Instead of a ton of autotiles to choose from, use 3 black ground tiles with varying amounts of grass to point your heroes in the right direction, and have the visual focus be on bioluminescent mushrooms and flowers! Small fairy rings of mushrooms and little glowing flowers can add a hint of magic to relatively normal maps with lush bushes and trees, and massive mushrooms and moonflowers that loom over your heroes’ heads will surely let them know that they’re not in a normal forest anymore. Organic lines of moss and vines are perfect for making the edges of the explorable area, so you can create open spaces without filling the entire map with tiles. Add a glowing river that cuts through the maps that can act as healing points or refill magic potions, or make a pool of water with a waterfall emptying into it the center of the forest that also acts as the home to a powerful optional boss.

This pack also includes 3 character sprites for glowing orbs. Use them to mark the path for your heroes, or have them act as fearful fairies that vanish if your heroes get too close. Or have pale orbs react to touch to light up the area to reveal hidden pathways and treasures. If you’ve been wanting to add a unique magical spring tucked away in a normal forest, pick up the KR Phosphor Forest Tileset!


The Phosphor Forest Tileset Includes:

Ground tiles that may be simple, but the edges aren’t. You get basic black tiles overlaid with simple grass paths, to give texture and direction…
…but combine them with a complex system of edges to make organic edges that look anything but blocky.
Then add moss! Layer it up to make thick greenery that disappears into the darkness below.
Glowing vine “bridges” and “ladders” light a clear way for players to proceed from one floating island to another.
Make shining lakes with bright blue, glowing waters!

Top it all off with:

glowing moonflowers
luminous mushrooms
phosphorescent crystals
unique lanterns
fairy lights
and more!

Events and Animations:

Fairy light animations give a sense of motion to your forest! You get several styles, bright and dim.


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
